title: Afterhours Account Executive
description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining high-quality services consistently.
We achieve the mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!
Our client is a leading US-based technology-enabled transportation and logistics company providing comprehensive freight brokerage and supply chain management services across North America. They leverage proprietary technology platforms to deliver efficient, reliable transportation solutions for their customers.
We are looking for an Afterhours Account Executive with experience in U.S. logistics, freight brokerage, or expedited transportation. The primary focus will be managing expedited freight, especially smaller equipment such as cargo vans, Sprinter vans, and box trucks. The role will include tracking active shipments, sourcing carriers, coordinating pickups and deliveries, resolving after-hours issues, and communicating with customers. When expedited volume is low, the person will also support Truckload operations through tracking, carrier communication, and general load support.
Key Responsibilities

• Source carriers and secure capacity for expedited shipments, including cargo vans, Sprinter vans, and box trucks.

• Dispatch small equipment and Truckload shipments for specific customers.

• Track active expedited shipments and monitor their status from pickup to delivery.

• Communicate with drivers, carriers, customers, and internal teams to provide timely updates.

• Handle after-hours issues, delays, missed appointments, and other shipment-related problems.

• Coordinate pickups and deliveries and make sure shipments stay on schedule.

• Enter loads and update shipment information in the TMS as needed.

• Maintain regular customer communication and respond to shipment-related questions.

• Support Truckload operations during slower expedited periods, including tracking and carrier communication.

• Proactively resolve operational issues to ensure smooth shipment execution and strong customer service.

Requirements

• 1+ years of experience in U.S. freight brokerage, logistics, dispatch, or expedited transportation.

• Hands-on experience with expedited freight and smaller equipment , such as cargo vans, Sprinter vans, and box trucks.

• Strong experience in carrier sourcing, dispatching, shipment tracking, and issue resolution.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently in an after-hours environment.

Working conditions :

• Working schedule: Friday - Monday 8am-6pm CST

• Work mode - hybrid/remote

• Competitive Salary in USD

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• Equipment provided

• A supportive team

• Remote eligibility

Join our team and become an integral part of our mission to provide reliable and efficient freight transportation solutions to our customers.
Highlights
US Logistics
Brokerage
Expedited freight

You understand that hiring decisions are business decisions, and you hold yourself accountable to the same outcomes as the teams you hire for. You're hands-on, sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to shape teams that win. We're looking for:

title: Product Manager 2 – IaC Detection
description:
As a Product Manager - IaC Detection, you will define, build, and launch capabilities that proactively detect infrastructure issues in code (e.g. Terraform, Helm) before they can be deployed into production and escalate into production incidents. The Infrastructure Monitoring team has pioneered shift-left detection in the industry with Bits Infrastructure Operations , and we’re looking for a Product Manager to expand this capability to a broader set of use cases 

Customers (and thus developers) are increasingly standardizing on IaC tools to deploy and maintain ever-growing infrastructure in the cloud. At the same time, SREs and Infra teams struggle with an increasing number of production incidents. By shifting-left and identifying high-impact infra changes before they are deployed, we help reduce production incidents, reduce waste, and free up SRE time to focus on value-added tasks. You will own the roadmap to expand IaC detection to a broader set of use cases, including cost detection, blast radius impact, as well as configuration changes on infrastructure powering applications like nginx, postgres and more. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, and customers to build and iterate on the roadmap, build product market fit, drive customer adoption (including internal usage), and focus on coverage and correctness of the AI system. This is an opportunity to lead an initiative at the intersection of AI, infrastructure operations, and autonomous observability.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

•
Lead the product roadmap for IaC Detection, enabling customers to proactively detect and catch high-impact infrastructure and configuration changes before they are deployed into production and escalate into incidents. 

•
Define the end-to-end experience across the Datadog UI, developer workflows (e.g. GitHub). Partner with Design and Engineering to create user-facing experiences.

•
Work with customers, including Datadog, to drive adoption and iterate the product

•
Collaborate cross-functionally with infrastructure monitoring, AI product teams, and other teams in Datadog to integrate IaC detection capabilities across the Datadog platform.

•
Establish quality standards and success metrics, including coverage, correctness, and user trust.

Who You Are:

•
3+ years of Product Management experience shipping technical products in cloud infrastructure or SaaS environments, ideally for developer or operator audiences.

•
You love building with AI, are excited about AI, and its potential to change the way infrastructure is monitored and managed

•
You have a technical background and/or sense of the day in the life of an engineer/developer shipping, maintaining, or securing a distributed cloud application 

•
Ability to drive product-led growth for a new 0-1 initiative targeting developers by identifying design partners, fast iteration and building product market fit.

•
Clear and concise communicator who can lead cross-functional initiatives and align stakeholders around a shared vision.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

•
Generous and competitive benefits package

•
New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

•
Continuous career development and pathing opportunities

•
Employee-focused best in class onboarding

•
Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program

•
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. title: Lead Product Data Scientist
description:
At Gradient Labs , we're building the AI customer operations platform for financial services.
Founded in 2023, we now work with some of the biggest names in banking and fintech. Our platform runs specialist agents, purpose-built for financial services, to eliminate manual work across customer support and back-office operations. Together, they give product and operations teams the visibility and control to trust every outcome.
We're a team of builders from companies like Monzo, Wise, Revolut and Google. If you're excited to tackle some of the hardest problems in AI and help shape the future of customer operations, we'd love to hear from you.
🎯 How you’ll make an impact
This is a role where you’ll own opportunities and outcomes all the way from conversations with customers to testing hypotheses, running experiments, and proposing and delivering optimisations in our agent.
You will:

• Be at the frontline of our product - talk to customers and align directly on what success looks like and how it’s measured. You’ll use raw, real-world data to form clear, actionable insights.

• Directly optimise the performance of our agent, tuning and improving it against those metrics for every customer we onboard.

• Own the optimisation flow end to end - you’ll use data to translate opportunities into tangible improvements in our agent, and close the loop by delivering and demonstrating that value.

• Get obsessive with the data: understand the data at the lowest level, then leverage this to form and test robust hypotheses about the bigger picture.

• Work across multiple teams and functions to bring shared understanding of where the highest impact opportunities are and how we deliver on them. Own your work end to end and scope your own initiatives - you'll be given real trust and independence, not a ticket queue.

• Turn ad hoc analyses and findings into powerful, scalable tooling for teammates and customers to self-serve.

💡 What you’ll bring

• Significant data science experience at a lead/staff level; building robust data pipelines is second nature, you’re fluent in SQL and Python, and have a strong understanding of statistical methods.

• A background working in a startup or a fast-moving tech environment, close to the product or customer side of the business.

• A knack for solving data puzzles and going from SQL queries to clear conclusions and next steps.

• A strong product mindset and pragmatic approach - you understand the right tradeoffs to make and can move fast to deliver product and business impact.

• Expert communication skills; this role will be partially customer-facing.

• Confident using AI to unlock efficiencies in your day-to-day while maintaining a high standard of output.

Why join Gradient Labs ?
This is a unique chance to be part of a team working with cutting-edge technology to reshape how businesses will operate in the future. Over the next 10 years, every company will need to embrace AI-powered operations to stay competitive, and this role puts you right in the middle of that transformation.
You’ll tackle challenging and new problems, work with some of the most exciting brands across different industries, and be surrounded by a passionate, smart team that’s driven to build something groundbreaking.

•

title: Director, GTM Systems & AI Transformation
description:
About Snorkel

At Snorkel, we believe meaningful AI doesn’t start with the model, it starts with the data.

We’re on a mission to help enterprises transform expert knowledge into specialized AI at scale. The AI landscape has gone through incredible changes since 2015, when Snorkel started as a research project in the Stanford AI Lab, to the generative AI breakthroughs of today. But one thing has remained constant: the data you use to build AI is the key to achieving differentiation, high performance, and production-ready systems. We work with some of the world’s largest organizations to empower scientists, engineers, financial experts, product creators, journalists, and more to build custom AI with their data faster than ever before. Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

Director, GTM Systems & AI Transformation

Reports to: VP, Revenue Operations Team: Senior GTM Transformation Specialist, Senior GTM Engineer Location: San Francisco

 

About the Role

Snorkel AI's Revenue Operations team designs, builds, and runs the systems, data, and processes that power our Go-to-Market motion. The Director, GTM Systems & AI Transformation leads that effort end-to-end - from systems architecture to workflow automation to AI-enabled process innovation - and manages a small, high-leverage systems team.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can own the technical roadmap and transform the GTM motion. You'll partner directly with Sales, Delivery, Marketing, Finance, and Legal to make sure our systems reflect how the business actually needs to run, and you'll be a trusted business partner to every team you touch.

 

What You'll Own

Systems Strategy & Architecture

• Partner with GTM leaders to define and evolve the systems architecture strategy across Sales, Delivery, Customer Success, Marketing, and more

• Set the roadmap for Salesforce and the broader GTM stack (Gong, Clay, Ironclad, Float, CPQ, billing/revenue automation, and future tooling)

• Own Salesforce architecture, data integrity, and data hygiene as the foundation of the role - new automation and AI initiatives get built on top of a clean, well-governed baseline

• Own vendor relationships and renewals across the GTM stack

 

Team Leadership

• Manage and grow the team, setting priorities and reviewing technical design

• Turn ambiguous business requests from Sales, Delivery, and Finance into scoped, shippable system changes

• Establish an intake, prioritization, and release process so the team moves from reactive to proactive and keeps stakeholders informed

 

Data Governance & Process

• Define and enforce data hygiene standards and field/object governance across the CRM

• Own the orchestration and reliability of revenue data across the GTM ecosystem

• Partner with systems and data operations teams to ensure data quality, governance, and visibility across core GTM platforms

• Help architecture lead-to-cash processes - handoffs, approvals, escalation paths across Sales, Delivery, and Finance

• Partner with Enablement to roll out new features and ensure technology adoption

 

Automation & AI

• Lead AI transformation across GTM by identifying workflow automation and AI-enabled opportunities across the GTM funnel

• Implement high-impact AI use cases across the GTM lifecycle, including pipeline management, prospecting intelligence, forecasting signals, and customer insights.

• Define and evolve standardized end-to-end GTM processes that streamline execution through automation, integrations between systems, and the use of AI.

 

What You'll Bring

• 10+ years in Revenue/Sales/GTM Operations, Business Systems, or CRM architecture, including 3+ years leading and developing high-performing technical teams

• Deep, architecture-level Salesforce expertise (object model design, automation, integrations); certifications a plus

• Experience owning a GTM tool stack beyond Sal

title: Staff Accountant — Custodial Accounting
description:
Point C is a National third-party administrator (TPA) with local market presence that delivers customized self-funded benefit programs. Our commitment and partnership means thinking beyond the typical solutions in the market - to do more for clients - and take them beyond the standard “Point A to Point B.” We have researched the most effective cost containment strategies and are driving down the cost of plans with innovative solutions such as, network and payment integrity, pharmacy benefits and care management. There are many companies with a mission. We are a mission with a company.

Point C is seeking a detail-oriented and highly motivated Staff Accountant to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Controller, this role will serve as a key member of the Accounting Department and play an essential role in maintaining the integrity of financial records, supporting custodial account operations, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal controls.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong accounting foundation, exceptional attention to detail, and experience managing cash activity, reconciliations, and client or custodial accounts. This position requires the ability to analyze financial transactions, maintain accurate accounting records, and collaborate closely with operations, client service, and management teams.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Prepare monthly reconciliations and analysis of custodial accounts, ensuring accurate recording of client assets, cash transactions, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and balances.

• Monitor custodial account activity, investigating and resolving discrepancies or reconciling items in a timely manner.

• Ensure all custodial transactions are properly documented, authorized, and recorded in accordance with company policy and regulatory requirements, supporting the safeguarding of client assets through strong internal controls.

• Monitor aged receivables, communicate professionally with clients on outstanding balances, and support collection efforts while maintaining positive client relationships.

• Manage daily cash receipts, deposits, and custodial transaction totals, maintaining accurate records of all custodial cash movement.

• Prepare and record bank and cash reconciliation entries, ensuring timely reconciliation of revenue, receivables, and custodial cash balances.

• Monitor cash activity, assist with treasury management functions, and promptly investigate unusual transactions or variances.

• Participate in internal audits, compliance reviews, and process improvement initiatives to strengthen financial controls over custodial funds and client assets.

• Partner with operations, client service, and management teams to resolve accounting issues and improve financial processes.

• Identify opportunities to automate or streamline accounting and reconciliation procedures.

• Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, financial institutions, auditors, and external vendors.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

• 2+ years of accounting experience, preferably involving cash management, reconciliations, or custodial/client account administration.

• Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.

• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Registered Dietitian
description:
Job Description Summary
‎
Provides evidence-based nutrition care and education to patients participating in nutrition education and weight management programs. Conducts comprehensive nutrition assessments, provides individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy, develops patient-centered nutrition interventions, and collaborates with the interdisciplinary care team to address weight management, cardiometabolic risk, and sustainable health behaviors through virtual care.

Registered Dietitian performs a range of clinical assignments under general supervision, applying working knowledge and growing experience to recognize patterns and identify when senior consultation is needed. Decisions are made within established protocols and involve non-complex to moderately complex clinical situations. This job broadens clinical capabilities across routine case types and strengthens judgment through increasing experience in the discipline. ‎
How will you make an impact & Requirements
‎
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy to patients with diverse nutritional needs, including weight management, cardiometabolic risk reduction, and lifestyle-related health concerns, using evidence-based nutrition practices.

• Conduct comprehensive nutrition assessments and develop individualized nutrition prescriptions, interventions, and care plans that reflect patient health needs, cultural considerations, preferences, and achievable wellness goals.

• Deliver individual and group nutrition education using motivational interviewing, empathetic listening, and evidence-based counseling strategies to promote sustainable behavior change and active patient participation in care.

• Support patients participating in structured weight management programs, including patients using GLP-1 and other weight management medications, by providing nutrition strategies that promote appropriate intake, healthy behavior change, and sustained outcomes.

• Collaborate with primary care providers, RN care managers, health coaches, behavioral health clinicians, and other care team members to coordinate nutrition recommendations, monitor progress, and adjust nutrition plans based on patient needs and outcomes.

• Document nutrition assessments, interventions, patient goals, education, and follow-up activity accurately and timely in the electronic health record, and engage patients through telephone, video, and portal-based communication.

• Contribute clinical nutrition expertise to program and quality improvement activities by developing and updating patient education materials and provider job aids, participating in team and onboarding activities, and delivering nutrition-related presentations as assigned.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Astrana Health builds the technology that lets physician groups deliver value-based care: the systems that enables physicians to deliver higher quality care and keeps its payers, and its partners in sync. Our engineers work on anything from eligibility, claims, and authorizations data, integrations with payer and provider systems, clinical integrations, provider-facing tools, and the data platform that ties them together. The pace varies with the work. Some of it is fast iteration with real users. Some of it touches PHI, billing, or clinical decisions and has to be right the first time. We want engineers who can tell which kind of work is in front of them and adjust. We also expect engineers to work across the whole stack: database, backend, frontend, and the infrastructure that runs it.

As a Senior Engineer you own a product surface or a significant system end to end. We hand you problems rather than solutions. You take a fuzzy problem to a data model, an API, a UI, a rollout plan, and shipped software, and you bring the people around it with you: your PM, clinical and operations stakeholders, and the more junior engineers you mentor.

Our Values:

• Put Patients First

• Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams

• Operate with Integrity & Excellence

• Be Innovative

• Work As One Team

What You'll Do

• Own the architecture, reliability, and technical direction for a product surface or system.

• Ship full-stack features end to end, from schema and API through to the React UI. Iterate quickly where the risk is low and be thorough where it is not.

• Decompose larger problems into work that several people can pick up in parallel, and adjust as you learn.

• Design data models that survive requirements nobody has heard yet, and integrations that stay correct when the systems on the other side misbehave.

• Work with the data directly. Answer questions about eligibility, claims, and quality data with SQL, notice when the numbers look wrong, and build the reporting and analytics that clinics and operations teams rely on.

• Build authorization, audit trails, and PHI minimization into your designs from the start.

• Work directly with product managers, practice managers, and clinicians. Come back from a twenty-minute conversation with a better spec than the one you were handed.

• Handle production incidents in your area without needing someone more senior to drive.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and review code in a way that teaches.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering large, ambiguous features independently.

• Four-year undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering. Rare exceptions for outstanding experience.

• Full-stack experience. You are comfortable owning a feature from the database to the browser.

• Production experience with React.

• Docker and container-based development and deployment.

• Strong proficiency with AI development tools such as coding agents and assistants. You use them to move faster on the right work, review what they produce with the same rigor as any other code and know when a task is better done without them.

description:
Zet jij je tanden graag in complexe gebiedsontwikkelingsopgaven? Word jij ook zo blij van het aansturen van een project dat gedurende je betrokkenheid fysiek vorm krijgt? Wil je ook bijdragen aan het creëren van de leefomgeving van de toekomst? Niet door rapporten te schrijven, maar door een ontwikkelstrategie te bedenken die écht wordt uitgevoerd. Of door het bouwen van een coalitie met marktpartijen en overheden. Leer jij het liefst door samen te werken met gedreven collega’s? En geloof jij net als wij in denken, durven én doen? Dan is TwynstraGudde voor jou ‘the place to be’!

Wij werken als adviseurs, kwartiermakers en managers aan complexe ruimtelijke vraagstukken van publieke, semipublieke en private partijen. Haalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid zijn voor ons daarbij sleutelwoorden. Kenmerken van deze vraagstukken zijn de aanwezigheid van een maatschappelijke component, de complexe politiek bestuurlijke omgeving en het lokale of regionale schaalniveau. Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie van TwynstraGudde.

Wij maken impact op morgen én op overmorgen. Creatief zijn we, soms grensverleggend en tegelijkertijd pragmatisch. Opdrachtgevers kunnen op ons rekenen: onze kracht is om van strategie tot realisatie te komen. Wij werken aan inbreidingslocaties voor woningbouw, spoorzones, transformatie van brownfields, herontwikkeling van zorgterreinen en reconstructies van verrommeld buitengebied. Help jij hen, samen met ons, vooruit?
Jouw rol
Als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom) werk je aan grote én kleine opgaven.
Je kunt producten als grondexploitaties, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen en businesscases ontwerpen, doorrekenen, beoordelen én deze financiële informatie vertalen zodat besluitvorming op verschillende niveaus (ambtelijk en bestuurlijk) kan plaatsvinden. Samen met andere financieel experts, projectleiders en/ of bestuurders kun je een ontwikkelstrategie uitdenken en uitvoeren. Het gaat hierbij ook vaak om samenwerkingsopgaven tussen partijen, waarbij je moet laveren tussen belangen. Je kijkt hierbij over de grenzen van het project en je eigen vakgebied heen. Samen met collega’s sta je klaar voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je rol varieert sterk per project en omgeving. Hierin kun jij zelf je koers bepalen.
Jouw werkzaamheden

• Adviseren: doordat je inhoudelijk sterk bent, kun je opdrachtgevers van gedegen en diepgaand advies voorzien.

• Beslissingen nemen: je hakt knopen door als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom).

• Verbinden: je zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat er draagvlak ontstaat, bouwt aan coalities en verbindt partijen, in- en extern.

• Onderhandelen: je bent in staat om onderhandelingen te voeren met (markt)partijen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het sluiten van anterieure overeenkomsten.

• Managen: je overziet de te nemen stappen, zorg je voor integrale aansturing van het project en ben je gesprekspartner van bestuurders.

• Ontwikkelen: je denkt bewust na over je eigen leer- en ontwikkelpad en leert graag bij.

Je werkt aan meerdere kortlopende opdrachten naast elkaar of voor langere tijd aan één opdracht. Daarbij werk je zelfstandig of in teamverband en maak je natuurlijk ook deel uit van onze adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie, en van bredere samenwerkingsverbanden binnen het bureau als geheel.
Requirements
Jouw profiel
Je staat bekend als iemand die ruime kennis en ervaring heeft met de financiële kant van gebiedsontwikkelingen. Doordat je analytisch vaardig bent, kun je problemen snel identificeren en met je communicatieve kwaliteiten kun je tot de kern van vraagstukken komen. Je hebt gedegen kennis in huis van business cases, grondexploitaties en het inzetten van andere financiële instrumenten bij gebiedsontwikkelingen. Daarnaast zorgt jouw creativiteit voor haalbare oplossingen. Ook ben je in staat om processen te organiseren en draagvlak te creëren, en ben je creatief om tot haalbare oplossingen te kunnen komen. title: Klinisch Psycholoog Online - Digitale poli
description:
Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
Geen wachtkamers of vaste kantoortijden, maar ruimte voor flexibel werken vanuit huis en volledig digitaal, zonder in te leveren op persoonlijk contact of kwaliteit. Bij de Digitale Poli maak je deel uit van een enthousiast team dat werkt aan snelle, doelgerichte zorg met oog voor herstel, veerkracht en zingeving. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de GGZ.
Wat ga je doen?
Als klinisch psycholoog ben je regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair online team. Je voert zelfstandig psychotherapie en diagnostiek uit, met aandacht voor complexe problematiek. Je begeleidt basispsychologen en GZ-psychologen in opleiding, en draagt actief bij aan hun professionele groei.
Je werkt vanuit huis, maar staat er niet alleen voor: via dagelijks contact in overleggen en samenwerking binnen behandelingen blijf je verbonden met het team. Daarnaast lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod en een inspirerende leeromgeving. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit: het voeren van intakes, opstellen en evalueren van behandelplannen, systeemgesprekken, deelnemen aan overleggen, uitvoeren van ROM-onderzoek en het ontwikkelen van (groeps)therapieën.
Wat hebben we jou te bieden?
Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.
Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGz) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.
Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

• Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 6.798,- tot € 9.442,- (FWG 75 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

• Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

• 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

• Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

• Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

• Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

• Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een klinisch psycholoog met een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve houding. Je ziet kansen in digitale zorg en durft te pionieren in een dynamisch en veranderend veld. Tegelijkertijd werk je zorgvuldig en zelfstandig, met een scherp oog voor complexe problematiek en het vermogen om regie te houden over behandelingen. Je gelooft in herstelgerichte zorg, werkt vanuit het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid en zet digitale middelen doelgericht in om écht van betekenis te zijn voor de cliënt.
Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die collega’s weet te begeleiden en graag bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod. Je hebt ervaring met individuele en groepsbehandelingen, blijft rustig in hectiek en schakelt snel wanneer dat nodig is. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, bent BIG-geregistreerd als klinisch psycholoog - of je bent bijna klaar met je opleiding - en je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verb

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

This role is based in Tokyo. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Please note that your resume must be submitted in English, and the interview process will include conversations in both languages.

In this role, you will:

- Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

- Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. • Core daytime hours with occasional flexibility needed around major launches or jurisdictional go-lives

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

• Competitive pay and benefits

• Flexible vacation allowance

• A hybrid / remote working environment

• Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques
We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Power System Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

As an Electrical and Power System Engineer, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the development of our next generation of satellites which will be even larger, more powerful, and more advanced than their predecessors. You will be part of a cross-functional team of talented engineers that owns the full development and operations cycle of the satellite electrical and power systems. The responsibilities of the team span a wide range of activities from requirements specification and architecture development up to post launch data reviews and anomaly investigations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain unit- and subsystem-level technical requirements.

• Lead trade studies, architecture development, and interface definition at the unit and subsystem level.

• Support detailed design activities, including creation and review of schematics, layouts, drawings, and bills of materials.

• Perform electrical and power analyses including power integrity (PI), transient analysis, worst-case circuit, derating, voltage drop, and grounding analyses.

• Perform DC, AC, and transient power integrity analysis (IR drop, impedance targets, load steps, resonances).

• Plan and lead unit- and subsystem-level acceptance and qualification testing, including test plan development, EGSE definition, test execution oversight, and test report generation.

• Lead failure investigations and support root-cause analysis during testing and operations.

• Conduct on-orbit data reviews and support anomaly investigation and resolution.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with strong academic performance.

• Familiarity with electrical power system components such as batteries, solar panels, harness, and power control and distribution units.

• Legally authorized to work in the US without employer sponsorship

• Excellent communication abilities, both written and verbal.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Familiarity with satellite power systems and space mission requirements.

• 2+ years of experience leading a team or technical project.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• 3-7 years of experience in power systems design and development, with a focus on space or aerospace applications preferred.

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, with emphasis on Power Electronics.

• Experience with LEO satellite power systems or similar space missions. 

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands .

At Soracom, our mission is Making Things Happen , For a World That Works Together . We believe connectivity has the power to transform industries, enable innovation, and help businesses solve real-world challenges. From startups launching their first connected product to global enterprises managing millions of devices, we empower our customers to bring their ideas to life.
With remote teams across Japan, the US, and Europe, Soracom continues to expand its global team to keep pace with the company's rapid growth. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in the diversity of our employees, valuing the unique experiences, perspectives, and expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. We believe in Developing a Dream Team by hiring exceptional people, investing in their growth, and creating an environment where individuals and teams can do their best work.
The ability to develop groundbreaking technologies is one of our key assets, and our people make it happen. Come join Soracom and help create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.
About the Role
Soracom is seeking a Customer Success Engineer / Architect to serve as the technical counterpart to our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) for strategic and high-growth accounts. • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and architectural improvements

• Troubleshoot complex connectivity and system issues in collaboration with internal teams

• Translate customer pain points into clear technical and business-aligned solutions

• Communicate customer feedback and requirements to product and engineering teams

• Collaborate cross-functionally to align customer needs with product direction and delivery

• Contribute to internal best practices and reusable assets to scale customer success efforts

• Collect and share competitive insights to inform product strategy

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in IoT, networking, cloud architecture, or cellular connectivity in customer-facing roles

• Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts clearl

Together, we blend imaginative storytelling and performance-driven strategies with cutting-edge technology to create engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients.

• Native Dutch speaker with excellent English skills, capable of working with Dutch and international brands.

• Ability to use humor in campaigns, creating engaging and memorable content.

• A proactive mindset with a small agency mentality with a drive to take initiative, lead projects, and deliver results without waiting for direction

As Direct Channels Fundraiser, ANZ, you will be our operational fundraising specialist in the market. You will deliver direct mail, telemarketing and other locally managed fundraising activity, working with internal colleagues and external suppliers to ensure campaigns are timely, compliant and effective. • Experience managing fundraising suppliers or other operational delivery partners.

title: Cloud Support Engineer (m/w/d)

deine mission
In dieser Rolle sicherst Du den operativen Suppport Betrieb unserer OpenStack-basierten Cloud-Infrastruktur und übernimmst gleichzeitig die technische End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Assets in diesem Kontext. das bringst du mit

was dich bei uns erwartet
In unserem Support-Team erhältst Du klare Verantwortlichkeiten für Deine Assets und arbeitest in einer strukturierten Umgebung, die Dir gleichzeitig den Freiraum lässt, bestehende Prozesse durch eigene Tool-Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Shape the future of institutional digital assets, connecting traditional capital markets with next-generation financial infrastructure.

The Role

At Capco, we're looking for a Business Analyst - Digital Assets to support the implementation and integration of the Taurus digital asset platform within a regulated traditional exchange.

You'll act as the functional bridge between business, technology, operations, and Taurus, helping translate complex requirements into practical solutions that enable secure, scalable, and efficient digital asset operations.

Working alongside the Implementation Lead and key stakeholders, you'll support the design and delivery of end-to-end digital asset capabilities spanning trading, custody, settlement, and integration with existing market infrastructure.

You'll also explore opportunities to use approved AI tools and AI-enabled workflows to improve requirements analysis, documentation, and delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, data security, and responsible AI practices.

• Support the Implementation Lead in the end-to-end implementation and integration of the Taurus digital asset platform, coordinating requirements, dependencies, and delivery activities across client, vendor, and implementation teams.

• Support integration with existing client systems and market infrastructure, facilitating stakeholder alignment, issue resolution, testing, go-live readiness, functional documentation, and operational handover.

• 5+ years of Business Analyst experience within financial services, capital markets, or financial-market infrastructure , with the ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional specifications and integration requirements.

• Experience implementing or integrating digital asset or distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms, with a strong understanding of blockchain transaction flows, tokenized assets, and on-chain settlement.

• Proven ability to manage stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and external vendors, facilitating effective communication and coordination throughout complex implementation programmes.

• Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving capabilities, with an openness to AI-enabled ways of working and an understanding of responsible AI, human validation, and appropriate escalation procedures .

Bonus Points For

• Direct experience implementing or integrating the Taurus digital asset platform within institutional or regulated financial environments.

• Knowledge of tokenization, tokenized securities, and their application within traditional capital markets and exchange infrastructure.
